title: The Cipher of Tashkent Revisited
author: Petra Nystrom
blurb: Freya Reyes, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
